::: {#bio}
::: {.cursive}
Hello there! I'm an Associate Professor in the Department of Statistics at 
Cal Poly, in San Luis Obispo. {{< fa sun >}}

Professionally, I love teaching data science skills, 
learning how to make my classroom inclusive of a diverse set of learners
{{< fa image-portrait >}}, and advocating for the importance of qualitative research {{< fa pencil >}}. Some of my recent projects include:

- [Describing a student's trajectory for learning data science skills](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/26939169.2026.2616499)

- [Outlining a framework for evaluating "inclusive" teaching](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/26939169.2024.2449159)

- [Advocating for alternative grading in data science education](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3587102.3588816)

I'm also the lead PI on an [NSF grant](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/show-award/?AWD_ID=2334988&HistoricalAwards=false) focused on crafting a pedagogy (and pedagogical materials) to equitably integrate pair programming in data science courses.

Finally, I'm an enthusiastic supporter of undergraduate research! Some of my 
student's recent projects include:

- [Outlining the Landscape of Collaborative Programming Tools](https://virtual.oxfordabstracts.com/event/public/73693/submission/68)

- [Investigating Emoji and Description Surveys as an Avenue for Increasing the Accuracy of Students' Responses to Classroom Surveys](https://virtual.oxfordabstracts.com/event/public/73693/submission/9)

Outside of work, my wife and I have two fluffy cats {{< fa cat >}}. I love cooking, biking, coffee, traveling, and striving for balance. I love reading and am always trying to learn something new.
:::
